subject.title: fix(config): reject gateway.port values above TCP port range

question: Should Doctor preserve the former runtime fallback by rewriting newly invalid `gateway.port` values to `18789`, rather than removing the key or requiring manual selection?
rationale: The code change intentionally turns previously tolerated stored configuration into a startup validation failure; the preferred repair writes a persistent default and therefore defines upgrade behavior beyond the mechanical schema correction.

options.title: Confirm default-port repair
options.body: Accept the existing migration, which persists `18789` so repaired configurations retain the documented fallback port.

options.title: Choose a different recovery contract
options.body: Require a revised migration if invalid stored ports should be removed, surfaced for manual choice, or handled through another supported recovery path.

recommendation.title: Confirm default-port repair
recommendation.body: Accept the existing migration, which persists `18789` so repaired configurations retain the documented fallback port.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway-port review/history is the strongest available signal for the documented fallback and port-resolution contract.
